record.reason: The IJCAI primary PDF describes G-SalAlignMamba for RGB-D/RGB-T salient-object detection. It reports 30.41 FPS and 83.80M parameters and addresses geometric alignment, sparse foreground salience, and image decoder boundaries. These are visual segmentation/detection mechanisms; there is no LLM or language-serving evaluation.
record.title: G-SalAlignMamba: Geometry-Aware Vision Mamba for Dual-Modal Salient Object Detection
